note: Re-judged 2026-10-24 (independent auditor, authored none of 9c3697d0d1 or 439a413ffd). RFC 9774 Section 3: "Unless explicitly configured by a network operator to do otherwise (e.g., during a transition phase), BGP speakers:" ... "MUST use the "treat-as-withdraw" error handling behavior per [RFC7606] upon reception of BGP UPDATE messages containing AS_SETs or AS_CONFED_SETs in the AS_PATH or AS4_PATH [RFC6793]." The weak judgement of 926410a332 (AS4_PATH clause proven at positive polarity only, AS_SET only, 2-octet session only) is answered by new tags, not new code: TestRFC9774ReceiveAS4PathSetTreatAsWithdraw now carries positive and negative. Re-read its body: an UPDATE with a sequence-only AS_PATH and an AS4_PATH holding AS_SET or AS_CONFED_SET draws exact TreatAsWithdraw from Session.enforceRFC7606 with no error on a 2-octet session (rfc7607Session) and on a 4-octet eBGP session (firstASSession with ASN4), and the twin with a sequence segment in the set's place draws exact None on both, so the verdict is bound to the segment type alone and an over-withdraw of a clean AS4_PATH goes red. TestValidateAS4PathRejectsSetSegments (new positive) asserts for asn4 false and true exact TreatAsWithdraw, AttrCode 17 and the exact RFC 9774 Section 3 description for AS_SET, AS_CONFED_SET and a set beside AS 0, and its controls assert discard for AS 0 alone, nil for a clean path and nil from the set scan for a misframed path. The AS_PATH clause stays enforced by TestValidateASPathRejectsSetSegments and TestRFC9774ReceiveASSetTreatAsWithdraw (unchanged); TestRFC9774ReceiveASSetAcceptedByOperator proves the default through parsePeerFromTree and its false comment (AS4_PATH reaches its validator only on a 2-octet session) is corrected. Both earlier findings closed. Each claim states what its body checks. Discrimination records observed red: positive on both AS4_PATH units under rfc7607.go !acceptASSet forced false, negative under the rfc9774.go segment-type comparison inverted. The operator exception is an uncounted deviation recorded in rfc/short/rfc9774.md. Units ran green at HEAD.
